meta.title: Drop a zero from each side
meta.summary: SAMPLE 30% of 40: 3×4=12. The two dropped zeros already moved two decimal places.

success.message:
Session complete. Tens of percent of tens: drop a zero each, multiply, stop.

SAMPLE: 30% of 40=12, 80% of 70=56.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 30% of 40. Both are tens.

What is the tens-of-tens move?

choices.label: Drop a zero from each side, then multiply 3 × 4

wrong_start_shift_only.message:
Legal but slower. When both sides are tens, drop a zero each and multiply.

Return to the drop.

wrong_start_add.message:
Percent-of is a product, not a sum.

Return to the drop.

choices.label: Dropping two zeros is the same as two decimal places (a percent)
It is 12 by coincidence; I still need to divide by 100
Multiply 12 by 100 to put the zeros back

wrong_product_luck.message:
You already divided by 100 when you dropped both zeros. Stop.

Revisit why 12 is finished.

wrong_product_times_100.message:
That would be 1,200 — 30 times 40, not 30% of 40.

Revisit why 12 is finished.

check.message:
80% of 70. Drop zeros: 8 × 7.

What is it?

wrong_check_560.message:
Do not put zeros back. 8×7 is already 80% of 70.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_15.message:
Multiply the stripped tens: 8×7=56.

Try the check again.
